newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's GMexico no comment on Asarco share sale.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's GMexico no comment on Asarco share sale.

text.p: Grupo Mexico, Mexico's largest mining company, had no comment on Thursday regarding Asarco Inc.'s sale of 20 million series "L" shares of Grupo Mexico.
"No comment," Deputy Finance Director Carlos Oyanguren told Reuters in a brief telephone interview. Grupo Mexico is Mexico's predominant copper miner, also producing other base and precious metals.
Asarco said earlier Thursday it sold, in a private placement to institutional investors, the block of shares at 22 pesos per share for gross proceeds of about $54.9 million.
Grupo Mexico's "L" series shares ended trading Wednesday at 22 pesos per share. Prices raced ahead in mid-session to 23.1 pesos per share, up 1.10 percent.
In the past, Asarco has made no secret it wanted to offload its share holding in Grupo Mexico. This placement is the mining giant's first move in this respect.

Asarco said the sale leaves it with 84.2 million "L" series shares, representing 12.2 percent of Grupo Mexico's total outstanding shares. Asarco added it also holds a quantity of GMexico "B" shares that bring its stake to 20.7 percent.
